alert.title: Search timeouts and errors spiked once a new ranking flag reached full rollout
alert.symptoms: Right after the enable_semantic_rerank flag was ramped to 100%, search p99 latency exceeded 25s and error rate hit about 38%; traffic levels are normal.
alert.error_message: query-executor timeout while feature flag enable_semantic_rerank is active

response.root_cause: The enable_semantic_rerank flag introduced a regression in the ranking algorithm causing query executor timeouts, which spiked search latency and errors.
response.blast_radius: All search-api requests for all users experience elevated latency and failures, degrading the search experience platform‑wide.
first_actions: Roll back or reduce the enable_semantic_rerank flag rollout to a safe percentage
Collect and examine query‑executor timeout logs and stack traces to pinpoint the regression
Increase monitoring of search latency and error rates and set alerts for further spikes

New alert: Search timeouts and errors spiked once a new ranking flag reached full rollout. Service: search-api, severity: SEV2.
Symptoms: Right after the enable_semantic_rerank flag was ramped to 100%, search p99 latency exceeded 25s and error rate hit about 38%; traffic levels are normal.
Error: query-executor timeout while feature flag enable_semantic_rerank is active

Evidence (only these incidents may be cited):
Incident INC-014 (search-api, SEV2, 2026-07-08T10:52:09Z):
Symptoms: search-api p99 latency jumped to 31.2s and error rate to 41% immediately after the enable_fuzzy_search_v2 flag hit 100% rollout.
Root cause: The fuzzy_search_v2 flag enables expensive Levenshtein-distance matching across the full catalog index for every query; at 100% rollout this exceeded the query-executor's 30s timeout under normal traffic.
Resolver: Sofia Martinez

Ranked fixes (use the top one as first_actions[0]):
  1. disable_feature_flag (score=+0.667, worked=1, partial=0, failed=0, recent_failures=0)
Recurrence: This is occurrence #2 of this pattern.
